A classic then, a classic now.



Translating to “you & me” in French, toi et moi jewelry has been around since the 1700s (romantic, right?) but you’ve never seen it done quite like this.



Choose two subtle birthstones—one to represent you, one to represent your loved one—and wear with anything and everything. We specifically chose these birthstones to be muted and easy to style, so you can love them for a lifetime.



To order, choose a Grand Baguette birthstone (that’s the larger pendant) and an Aura birthstone (that’s the smaller pendant)! Also available in sterling silver and solid gold.

 

Please note: We intentionally curated this palette using a variety of lab-made stones and natural gemstones (see product details for more info). Expect natural variances in color across pieces; no two gemstones are alike, and may not mirror the photos exactly.
